name: Brumal-Tarn
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in a nearby asteroid belt. Travelers navigate by massive canyon systems and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.
Thin air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
Trade at the pirate hideout changes hands often and quietly. Its current occupants deal fuel for silence and ask no questions about cargo.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on titanium, platinum, rare flora and geothermal energy are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
